primary_estimands: Equal-suite canonical accuracy change from base at each trained adapter scale.
Exact 28-task protocol score at each scale.
Full-scale trained minus row-sign-randomized canonical accuracy.

analysis_plan.pairing: Require identical lm-eval document, prompt, and target hashes across every condition.
analysis_plan.confidence_intervals: 20,000 paired item bootstraps, equal weighting across four suites and across MMLU subjects.
analysis_plan.scale_curve: Report every fixed scale. Test monotonic association descriptively; do not select or omit scales.
analysis_plan.pareto_rule: A scale is protocol-preserving only at 28/28. Among preserving scales, report the one with highest measured canonical macro accuracy without claiming an unbiased optimum.
analysis_plan.randomized_control: Row-sign flips of every LoRA B output row preserve each B Frobenius norm exactly while disrupting learned output coordinates. Compare with both base and trained scale 1.0.

training_policy: No benchmark or protocol item in this study may be used for training, adapter repair, model selection, or retries.
failure_policy: Technical failures are blocked. Compatibility-only repairs require a committed amendment and full rerun; observed scores cannot guide repairs.
limitations: One checkpoint and one frozen adapter.
The scale study changes all LoRA modules together and does not localize layers.
Row-sign randomization preserves B norms but not singular vectors or the exact B@A spectrum.
Protocol seeds are diagnostic, not admission certification.
